9	/-!
10	# The Abel chart map of the degree-zero Picard sheaf
11	
12	`JacobianData.ofCharts` consumes a family of morphisms of big-site presheaves
13	`yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ pic0SigmaFunctor C`.  This file builds such a morphism out of the two
14	things the tree already has: the Abel transformation of divisor families into the degree-zero
15	Picard functor on the slice, and a representation of the divisor functor by a scheme.
16	
17	The passage from the slice to the big site is the Σ-extension, and it is functorial in two
18	independent ways, both established here in the general categorical setting:
19	
20	* `CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat` — the Σ-extension is functorial in the extended
21	  presheaf: a natural transformation `F ⟶ G` of presheaves on the slice `Over S` induces one
22	  of presheaves on the ambient category.
23	* `CategoryTheory.Functor.RepresentableBy.toSigmaExtension` — a representation of `F` by an
24	  object `J` of the slice induces a morphism `yoneda.obj J.left ⟶ sigmaExtension S F` from the
25	  ambient yoneda presheaf of the underlying object.  A point of `J.left` over a test `V` is a
26	  map `v : V ⟶ J.left`, and it names the Σ-element whose structure morphism is `v ≫ J.hom` and
27	  whose fibre component is the universal element pulled back along `v`.
28	
29	Composing the second with the first at the Abel transformation gives the chart map.
30	
31	## Main declarations
32	
33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartValueTrans` — **the Abel transformation into the degree-zero Picard
34	  functor**: under the chart-index degree constraint `deg Z = m·d₁ − n`, the chart value
35	  `abelDiv s · sigmaFamily Z · (θ^m)⁻¹` of `DivSchemeAbel.lean` is a natural transformation
36	  `divFunctor C π n ⟶ pic0TypeFunctor C`.  Naturality is `picEtMap_chartValue`, membership is
37	  `chartValue_mem_pic0Subgroup`.
38	* `AlgebraicGeometry.abelSigmaChart` — **the Abel chart map**: given a representation of the
39	  divisor functor by a scheme `D` over `k` (a section variable — this file never constructs
40	  one), the morphism of big-site presheaves
41	  `yoneda.obj D.left ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1` sending a `D`-point to the class of the divisor
42	  family it names, twisted into degree zero.
43	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartHom_abelSigmaChart` — the structure morphism of the single chart of
44	  this family is the structure morphism of the representing object, so the chart hypothesis
45	  `LocallyOfFiniteType (chartHom …)` of `JacobianData.ofCharts` is exactly
46	  `LocallyOfFiniteType D.hom` for it.
47	
48	## What this is NOT
49	
50	This is the chart *map*, not a chart *atlas*.  Neither of the two properties
51	`JacobianData.ofCharts` needs is established here, and neither is available anywhere in the
52	tree today:
53	
54	* `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (abelSigmaChart …)` is **false as stated for the whole divisor
55	  scheme** — the Abel map of a degree-`n` divisor scheme onto the Picard functor has projective
56	  spaces `|D|` as its fibres, so it is not a monomorphism, let alone an open immersion.  It
57	  becomes an open immersion only after restricting to the open locus where the fibre is a single
58	  point, i.e. where `h⁰ = 1`; that locus is the reserved `chartLocus` of `w4-datc` §3.3.
59	
60	  Two updates to this bullet, both 2026-07-29.  `chartLocus` **now exists in Lean**
61	  (`Picard/Pic0ChartLocus.lean`, and open at a general test unconditionally), so the closing
62	  clause above — that it does not — is stale.  And the implication "not a monomorphism, hence
63	  not `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf`" is a **derivation**, not an extra fact: it is
64	  `mono_of_isOpenImmersion_presheaf` (`Picard/Pic0ChartOpenImmersionCriterion.lean`), from
65	  mathlib's `presheaf_mono_of_le` at `IsOpenImmersion.le_monomorphisms`.  The same file gives
66	  the criterion that makes the restricted statement provable, and
67	  `Picard/Pic0ChartUnivReduce.lean` instantiates it here.
68	* `Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (Sigma.desc …)` is the statement that
69	  every degree-zero class is Zariski-locally the twisted class of a divisor family in the
70	  window.  Over a field this is Riemann–Roch; the relative statement is DAT-B's coverage row.
71	-/
72	
73	set_option autoImplicit false
74	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
75	
76	universe v u
77	
78	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
79	
80	/-! ## Σ-extension plumbing (general category theory)
81	
82	Both constructions below are stated for presheaves valued in `Type v`, the hom-universe of the
83	ambient category, because that is where the ambient yoneda presheaf lives and the Σ-extension
84	must meet it. -/
85	
86	namespace CategoryTheory
87	
88	namespace Over
89	
90	variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {S : C} {F G : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v}
91	
92	/-- **The Σ-extension is functorial in the extended presheaf**: a natural transformation of
93	presheaves on the slice induces one of their Σ-extensions, acting as the identity on the
94	structure-morphism component. -/
95	def sigmaExtensionNat (φ : F ⟶ G) : sigmaExtension S F ⟶ sigmaExtension S G where
96	  app T := TypeCat.ofHom fun x => ⟨x.1, φ.app _ x.2⟩
97	  naturality T T' g := by
98	    refine ConcreteCategory.hom_ext _ _ fun x => ?_
99	    obtain ⟨a, ξ⟩ := x
100	    exact congrArg (Sigma.mk (g.unop ≫ a))
101	      (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (φ.naturality (Over.homMk g.unop rfl :
102	        Over.mk (g.unop ≫ a) ⟶ Over.mk a).op) ξ)
103	
104	@[simp]
105	lemma sigmaExtensionNat_app_fst (φ : F ⟶ G) (T : Cᵒᵖ) (x : (sigmaExtension S F).obj T) :
106	    ((sigmaExtensionNat φ).app T x).1 = x.1 :=
107	  rfl
108	
109	end Over
110	
111	namespace Functor.RepresentableBy
112	
113	open Over
114	
115	variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {S : C} {F : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v}
116	
117	/-- The elementwise naturality identity behind `toSigmaExtension`, stated on the raw
118	Σ-extension transition function so that no bundled-hom coercion intervenes. -/
119	private lemma toSigmaExtension_aux {J : Over S} (α : F.RepresentableBy J)
120	    {T T' : C} (g : T' ⟶ T) (v : T ⟶ J.left) :
121	    (⟨(g ≫ v) ≫ J.hom, α.homEquiv (Over.homMk (g ≫ v) rfl)⟩ :
122	        Σ a : T' ⟶ S, F.obj (op (Over.mk a)))
123	      = Over.sigmaExtensionMap S F g ⟨v ≫ J.hom, α.homEquiv (Over.homMk v rfl)⟩ := by
124	  refine sigmaExtension_ext F (Category.assoc g v J.hom) ?_
125	  show F.map (mkCongr (Category.assoc g v J.hom)).op
126	      (F.map (Over.homMk g rfl :
127	        Over.mk (g ≫ (v ≫ J.hom)) ⟶ Over.mk (v ≫ J.hom)).op
128	        (α.homEquiv (Over.homMk v rfl))) = _
129	  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← op_comp, ← α.homEquiv_comp]
130	  refine congrArg α.homEquiv (Over.OverMorphism.ext ?_)
131	  exact congrArg (fun z : T' ⟶ T => z ≫ v) (Category.id_comp g)
132	
133	/-- **The ambient presheaf map of a slice representation**: if `F` on the slice `Over S` is
134	represented by `J`, then the ambient yoneda presheaf of `J.left` maps to the Σ-extension of `F`.
135	A `V`-point `v : V ⟶ J.left` is sent to the Σ-element with structure morphism `v ≫ J.hom` and
136	fibre component the universal element restricted along `v`.
137	
138	This is the input shape of mathlib's 01JJ engine: a scheme mapping to a big-site presheaf. -/
139	def toSigmaExtension {J : Over S} (α : F.RepresentableBy J) :
140	    yoneda.obj J.left ⟶ sigmaExtension S F where
141	  app _ := TypeCat.ofHom fun v => ⟨v ≫ J.hom, α.homEquiv (Over.homMk v rfl)⟩
142	  naturality _ _ g :=
143	    ConcreteCategory.hom_ext _ _ fun v => toSigmaExtension_aux α g.unop v
144	
145	@[simp]
146	lemma toSigmaExtension_app_fst {J : Over S} (α : F.RepresentableBy J) (T : Cᵒᵖ)
147	    (v : T.unop ⟶ J.left) :
148	    ((α.toSigmaExtension).app T v).1 = v ≫ J.hom :=
149	  rfl

9	/-!
10	# C9b: `IsChartUniv` reduced to one clause about the chart locus
11	
12	`Picard/Pic0ChartOpenImmersionCriterion.lean` splits `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` into the two
13	clauses mathlib's `MorphismProperty.relative` actually conjoins, and gives a criterion whose
14	input is elementwise.  This file instantiates that criterion at the Abel chart and at
15	`V := chartLocus`, which is the pair `pic0RepresentableByOfCharts` consumes.
16	
17	The point is to make the residue **one named clause about the chart locus** instead of the
18	whole certificate.  Concretely, the criterion's `ChartFibrePresented` datum has four fields,
19	and at the Abel chart three of them are supplied here:
20	
21	| field | at the Abel chart | status |
22	|---|---|---|
23	| `W` | `chartLocus` of the test point's class, as an open | **supplied here** — by the
24	  unconditional `isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal'` |
25	| `r` | the divisor family over the locus | the classifier `divRepClassifyZar` |
26	| `sq` | its class is the test's class | the classifier's own characterisation |
27	| `exists_factor` | uniqueness of the normalized representative | **the relative form of GAP-2** |
28	
29	So `W` needs nothing, `sq` is a property of whatever `r` is, and the genuine content is
30	concentrated in `r` (a construction, from the classifier) and `exists_factor` (relative
31	GAP-2).  This file makes that split machine-checkable: `IsChartLocusFibre` below names
32	exactly the `r`/`sq`/`exists_factor` triple **at the chart locus**, and
33	`isChartUniv_of_isChartLocusFibre` proves `IsChartUniv` from it.
34	
35	## Why this is not a restatement
36	
37	A reduction that merely renames its obligation is worthless, and this one is checked against
38	that failure mode in two directions:
39	
40	* `chartLocusOpens` is **constructed**, not hypothesised — the `W` field costs zero, which
41	  is a real reduction of the datum from four fields to three;
42	* `isChartLocusFibre_of_isChartUniv` is the **converse**: `IsChartUniv` at the chart locus
43	  gives injectivity on every test, so a lane cannot obtain `IsChartUniv` while avoiding the
44	  content of `exists_factor`.  The reduction is therefore an equivalence in the direction
45	  that matters, not a weakening.
46	
47	## Main declarations
48	
49	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartLocusOpens` — `chartLocus` as an honest `T.Opens`, using the
50	  unconditional general-test openness.  This is the `V` that `restrictChart` wants.
51	* `AlgebraicGeometry.IsChartLocusFibre` — the residue: the `r`/`sq`/`exists_factor` triple
52	  of the criterion, at the chart locus, for every test point.
53	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isChartUniv_of_isChartLocusFibre` — **the reduction**: that triple
54	  gives `IsChartUniv` (hence the `hf` of the `(f, hf)` pair) at any open.
55	* `AlgebraicGeometry.injective_of_isChartUniv` — the converse-direction check.
56	-/

74	/-! ## The chart locus as an open of the test
75	
76	`chartLocus` is a `Set T.left` and `restrictChart` wants a `T.Opens`.  The bridge is the
77	openness theorem, which is now unconditional — so this costs a hypothesis-free definition
78	rather than a gate. -/
79	
80	variable (C) in
81	/-- **`chartLocus` as an open subscheme of the test.**
82	
83	For a test `T` presented as `Over.mk a` and a class `lam` on it, the chart locus is open by
84	`isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal'` (CHART-U(b) at a general test, unconditional since
85	`IsSplitWitnessIsoInvariant` was discharged), so it is an honest element of `T.Opens`.
86	
87	The `haff` hypothesis is the affine-local input of that theorem and is *not* a residue of
88	this file: it is what the landed affine openness supplies.  It is carried as an argument
89	here so that the definition does not silently depend on a chosen route to it. -/
90	def chartLocusOpens (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
91	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T)
92	    (haff : ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,
93	      IsOpen (chartLocus C m Z (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam))) :
94	    T.left.Opens where
95	  carrier := chartLocus C m Z lam
96	  is_open' := isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal' C m Z T lam haff
97	
98	@[simp]
99	lemma mem_chartLocusOpens {m : ℕ} {Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor}
100	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {lam : picEt C T}
101	    {haff : ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,
102	      IsOpen (chartLocus C m Z (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam))}
103	    {t : T.left} :
104	    t ∈ chartLocusOpens C m Z T lam haff ↔ t ∈ chartLocus C m Z lam :=
105	  Iff.rfl

107	/-! ## The residue, named -/
108	
109	variable (C π n) in
110	/-- **The residue of C9b, named**: for every test point of the Σ-sheaf, the chart point over
111	its chart locus together with the two properties the criterion needs.
112	
113	This is `ChartFibrePresented` with its `W` field already discharged — it is `chartLocus`,
114	open unconditionally — so what a lane owes is precisely:
115	
116	* `r`: the divisor family over the locus whose class is the given one.  This is the
117	  classifier `divRepClassifyZar` applied to the canonical-section family, i.e. CHART-U(c)'s
118	  construction;
119	* `sq`: that its chart value *is* the given class, which is the classifier's characterising
120	  property;
121	* `exists_factor`: that two points with the same class agree, i.e. the **relative form of
122	  DAT-C GAP-2** (`Scheme.CurveDivisor.eq_of_picClass_eq_of_h0_one` in families).
123	
124	Stated as a `Prop` over an arbitrary presenting datum rather than as a structure carrying the
125	family, because the family is the classifier's output and this lane must not guess its shape:
126	the existential is over morphisms of schemes only. -/
127	def IsChartLocusFibre {D : Over (Spec (.of k))} (rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D)
128	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
129	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
130	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ)) : Prop :=
131	  ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1),
132	    Nonempty (ChartFibrePresented C (abelSigmaChart C π n rep m Z hdeg) g)
133	
134	/-- **THE REDUCTION**: the residue above gives `IsChartUniv`, hence the `hf` of the `(f, hf)`
135	pair, at *any* open of the divisor scheme.
136	
137	Two things are worth reading off the proof.  First, it goes through the criterion of
138	`Pic0ChartOpenImmersionCriterion.lean` and then through the *composition* half
139	`isOpenImmersion_presheaf_restrictChart` already landed in `Pic0ChartPair.lean` — so the two
140	halves of C9b compose exactly as the file headers predicted, with no seam.  Second, the open
141	`V` is arbitrary: restriction never has to be to the chart locus for `hf` to hold, because
142	`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is stable under precomposition with an open immersion.  The chart
143	locus is where the *unrestricted* statement becomes true, which is a statement about
144	`IsChartLocusFibre`, not about `V`. -/
145	theorem isChartUniv_of_isChartLocusFibre {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
146	    (rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D)
147	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
148	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
149	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
150	    (h : IsChartLocusFibre C π n rep m Z hdeg) (V : D.left.Opens) :
151	    IsChartUniv C π n rep m Z hdeg V :=
152	  isOpenImmersion_presheaf_restrictChart V
153	    (isOpenImmersion_presheaf_of_chartFibrePresented _ fun T g => (h T g).some)
154	
155	/-! ## The converse check: the reduction is not a weakening -/
156	
157	/-- **`IsChartUniv` forces elementwise injectivity of the restricted chart.**
158	
159	The converse direction of the reduction, and the reason it is a reduction rather than a
160	restatement: a lane that obtains `IsChartUniv` has, for free, the injectivity statement that
161	`ChartFibrePresented.exists_factor` is the hard half of.  So there is no route to `hf` that
162	avoids relative GAP-2 — the gate is real, and this file has moved it rather than removed it.
163	
164	Compare `isEmpty_forall_chartFibrePresented_of_not_injective`: that says the criterion cannot
165	be *satisfied* without injectivity; this says the goal cannot be *reached* without it. -/
166	theorem injective_of_isChartUniv {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
167	    (rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D)
168	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
169	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
170	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
171	    (V : D.left.Opens) (h : IsChartUniv C π n rep m Z hdeg V) (T : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ) :
172	    Function.Injective ((restrictChart (abelSigmaChart C π n rep m Z hdeg) V).app T) :=
173	  injective_of_isOpenImmersion_presheaf h T
174	
175	end
176	
177	end AlgebraicGeometry

286	/-- **CHART-U(b) AT A GENERAL TEST, UNCONDITIONALLY.**
287	
288	If `chartLocus` is open over each affine-open test object of `T`, it is open over `T` — with no

291	theorem isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal' (m : ℕ)
292	    (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
293	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T)
294	    (haff : ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,

10	
11	`Picard/Pic0ChartLocalSurjectivity.lean` reduced B-6 to `ChartsCoverLocally`, whose statement

15	index per point of `T`".

18	produces is pointwise: for each point `t` of the test, an open `W ∋ t`, an index `i`, and a
19	chart point over `W` whose class restricts to `s`.  What `ChartsCoverLocally` asks for is
20	membership of a Grothendieck topology.  The two are connected by a *cover construction* —
21	`Scheme.Cover.mkOfCovers` at the family `{W t}` indexed by the points of `T` — and the
22	connection is what this file supplies.
23	
24	## Why the bridge is not bookkeeping the producer can inline
25	
26	Three things have to line up, and each is a place a lane would stall:
27	
28	* the cover must be indexed by a type in the right universe.  Indexing by the points of `T`
29	  works (`↥T : Type u` for `T : Scheme.{u}`) and is the *only* index available before any
30	  geometry is known — a producer that tries to index by a chosen finite subcover needs
31	  quasi-compactness, which no row assumes;

34	  be produced after destructing `ofArrows` — which binds the point, not an arbitrary map into

38	  at every point, which is the chart-parameter heterogeneity the dat-b row records — here it

structure-morphism component. -/
def sigmaExtensionNat (φ : F ⟶ G) : sigmaExtension S F ⟶ sigmaExtension S G where

    obtain ⟨a, ξ⟩ := x

/-!
# B-5 at the Abel chart: what the pointwise datum unfolds to, and what it costs

`Picard/Pic0ChartCoveragePointwise.lean` reduces `ChartsCoverLocally` — hence B-6 — to a
four-part datum at each point of each test.  That reduction is stated for an *arbitrary*
family of presheaf maps, so it says nothing about how hard the datum is at the family that
matters.  This file instantiates it at `abelSigmaChart` and computes the answer.

## The computation, and the one thing it makes visible

A section of `pic0SigmaSheaf C` over a **bare** test scheme `T` is by definition a *pair*
`⟨a, λ⟩` with `a : T ⟶ Spec k` and `λ` a degree-zero class on the slice object `Over.mk a`
(`Over.sigmaExtension`, `Picard/OverSigmaExtension.lean`).  And `(Over.mk a).left` is `T`
itself, definitionally.  So the big-site/slice crossing that looks like it needs a bridge does
not: the pointwise datum's `t : ↥T` *is* a point of the slice test, and `chartLocus` applies to
it with no transport.  `abelChartApp_eq` below records the crossing as an equation rather than
leaving it to unfold at a use site.

What the computation *does* make visible is where the cost sits.  `abelSigmaChart`'s value at
`x : W ⟶ D.left` is `⟨x ≫ D.hom, chartValue … (rep.homEquiv …)⟩`, so matching it against the
restriction of `⟨a, λ⟩` needs **both** components: the Σ-component is an equation between
morphisms to `Spec k`, and only then is there a class equation.  A producer that supplies the
class half alone has not supplied the datum — the Σ-component is what pins the chart point to
lie *over* the test, and it is free only because `W.ι ≫ a` is what `D.hom` must equal.

## THE CORRECTION THIS FILE CARRIES, against this lane's own headline

`Pic0ChartUnivReduce.lean:40` says of its `chartLocusOpens`:

> `chartLocusOpens` is **constructed**, not hypothesised — the `W` field costs zero, which is
> a real reduction of the datum from four fields to three

**The second clause is false, and the roadmap `c9b` row repeats it** ("`W` needs nothing").
`chartLocusOpens` takes an argument `haff`, the affine-local openness of the locus at every
affine open of the test, and *nothing in the tree discharges it*:
`isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal'` (`Pic0ChartLocusIsoInvariance.lean`) removed the
`IsSplitWitnessIsoInvariant` hypothesis and passes `haff` straight through, as does
`isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal` before it.  The affine case that would feed it is
`isOpen_setOf_isSplitWitness_of_presentation` (`Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen.lean:321`), which is
itself conditional on `IsChartDatumPresentation` — B-4's *named residue*, half landed
(`isChartDatumPresentation_of_plusFibre_of_converse` still owes `hconv`, the descent
direction).

So the honest accounting is: **`W` costs `haff`, which costs B-4's presentation residue.**  The
datum went from four fields to three *shapes* but not to three *obligations*.  What is
genuinely free is the type-level crossing above, and `chartLocusHaff` below is the residue
named so it cannot be lost again.

## Main declarations

* `AlgebraicGeometry.abelChartApp_eq` — the Abel chart's value at a point of the divisor
  scheme, as an explicit `Sigma.mk`.  Both components, since the datum needs both.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.ChartLocusAffineLocal` — the `haff` residue, named.  This is what
  `chartLocusOpens` silently costs.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartLocusOpens_of_affineLocal` — `chartLocusOpens` from it, so the
  dependency is explicit in the API rather than in an argument position.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartLocusAffineLocal_of_presentation` — the residue **reduced to B-4's
  own named obligation**: a per-affine-piece `IsChartDatumPresentation` gives it.  This is the
  link that was asserted in `Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen`'s docstring and never written.
-/

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π] {n : ℕ}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable section

/-! ## The Abel chart's value, both components -/

/-- **The Abel chart map evaluated at a point of the divisor scheme.**

`abelSigmaChart` is `rep.toSigmaExtension ≫ Over.sigmaExtensionNat (chartValueTrans …)`, and
both factors act componentwise on the Σ-extension, so the value at `x : Y ⟶ D.left` is the
pair whose structure morphism is `x ≫ D.hom` and whose class is the chart value of the divisor
family `rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk x rfl)`.

Recorded as an equation because a coverage producer has to match this against a *given*
section, and the match is two equations rather than one: the Σ-components must agree before
the classes are even in the same type.  Leaving it to unfold at the use site is how the
Σ-component gets forgotten. -/
@[simp]
theorem abelChartApp_eq {D : Over (Spec (.of k))} (rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D)
    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (x : Y ⟶ D.left) :
    (abelSigmaChart C π n rep m Z hdeg).app (op Y) x
      = ⟨x ≫ D.hom, ⟨chartValue C π n m Z (Over.mk (x ≫ D.hom))
          (rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk x rfl)),
        chartValue_mem_pic0Subgroup C π n m Z hdeg _ _⟩⟩ :=
  rfl

/-! ## The `haff` residue, named

`chartLocusOpens` takes the affine-local openness as an argument.  Naming it is not cosmetic:
an argument in a definition's signature is invisible to a census of open obligations, which is
how "the `W` field costs zero" survived into two roadmap rows. -/

variable (C) in
/-- **The affine-local openness residue of `chartLocus`** — what `chartLocusOpens` costs.

For a test `T` and a class `lam` on it, this says the chart locus is open over every affine
open piece of `T`.  It is exactly the `haff` argument of `isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal'`,
and it is the *only* remaining input to CHART-U(b) at a general test: the iso-invariance
hypothesis that used to sit beside it was discharged
(`isSplitWitnessIsoInvariant_holds`), but this one was passed through, not proved.

Named as a `Prop` so that it appears in searches for open obligations. -/
def ChartLocusAffineLocal (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T) : Prop :=
  ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,
    IsOpen (chartLocus C m Z (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam))

variable (C) in
/-- `chartLocusOpens` with its cost made explicit in the API.

Identical in content to `chartLocusOpens` — the point is that the dependency is now a named
`Prop` a reader can grep for, rather than an unnamed argument that reads as bookkeeping. -/
def chartLocusOpens' (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T)
    (haff : ChartLocusAffineLocal C m Z T lam) : T.left.Opens :=
  chartLocusOpens C m Z T lam haff

@[simp]
lemma mem_chartLocusOpens' {m : ℕ} {Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor}
    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {lam : picEt C T} {haff : ChartLocusAffineLocal C m Z T lam}
    {t : T.left} :
    t ∈ chartLocusOpens' C m Z T lam haff ↔ t ∈ chartLocus C m Z lam :=
  Iff.rfl

/-! ## Reducing the residue to B-4's own named obligation

`Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen.lean:321`'s docstring says the general-test statement follows from the
affine one "by the affine-piece locality of the (b-amendment)'s transport (iii)", and adds that
it "is not stated here only because it would need the presentation hypothesis *per affine
piece*".  That is right, and this is the statement it describes. -/

variable (C π) in
/-- **The `haff` residue from a per-affine-piece presentation** — the link
`Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen`'s docstring describes and does not state.

For each affine open `U` of the test, a `BasicOpenCocycleDatum` over `Γ(T.left, U)` presenting
the restricted twisted class gives openness of the locus on that piece
(`isOpen_setOf_isSplitWitness_of_presentation`), and `chartLocus` over the piece *is* that set
by definition (`chartLocus` unfolds to the split-witness set of the twisted class, and the
twist commutes with restriction by `picEtMap_chartTwist`).

So the affine-local residue is **exactly** B-4's presentation obligation, quantified over
affine pieces — no extra geometry, and in particular nothing certificate- or divRep-gated.
Combined with `isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal'` this closes CHART-U(b) at a general test the
moment `IsChartDatumPresentation` is available per piece.

The `hπ` hypothesis is the one `isOpen_setOf_isSplitWitness_of_presentation` carries. -/
theorem chartLocusAffineLocal_of_presentation (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T)
    (hpres : ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,
      ∃ D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C (Γ(T.left, U.1)) π,
        IsChartDatumPresentation C π
          (chartTwist C m Z _ (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam)) D) :
    ChartLocusAffineLocal C m Z T lam := by
  intro U
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hpres U
  exact isOpen_setOf_isSplitWitness_of_presentation C π hπ hD

end

end AlgebraicGeometry
